title: Raid action frame (agent -> server, inbound)
description: One squad member's action-set for the current raid tick: at most one action per controlled unit. A unit not listed Holds. Must echo the raid observation's turn_id AND nonce (anti-replay). Verbs mirror the duel (hold/move/attack) plus co-op verbs: `revive` (raise a downed ally) and `ability` (a role-granted affordance — options, never raw power; MISSION §4.4). Costs are canonical server-side, never client-declared. additionalProperties is false everywhere. Analogous to `wot:action:grid_tactics:1`.

dir.description: Orthogonal step direction. N=+y, E=+x, S=-y, W=-x.

steps.description: Ordered step list (NOT a destination), validated left-to-right; the first illegal step truncates the move.

target.description: Target CELL within range. Attack the boss/add by aiming at its cell; movement resolves before combat.

target_member.description: The downed squad member to raise. Must be adjacent/in-range per raids-v1.

ability_id.description: A role-granted affordance defined by the scenario (server-enforced, never client trust). Unknown/unauthorized -> per-unit coercion to Hold.

target.description: Optional target cell for the ability.

target_member.description: Optional target squad member for the ability.

turn_id.description: MUST equal the current raid observation's turn_id. A stale/future turn_id is rejected (`stale_turn`).

nonce.description: MUST equal the current observation's nonce. Mismatch/reuse -> `bad_echo`.

member_id.description: The acting squad member (MUST match the session's bound member). A member can only act for its own units.

units.description: 0..8 unit actions. At most one action per unit_id; a duplicate unit_id is schema_invalid. A unit omitted here Holds.

thought.description: OPTIONAL spectator commentary (<=200 chars, <=1/tick). NEVER parsed by the engine; sanitized; shown to spectators on a delay. Squad chat is NOT this channel.

examples.thought: Taunting the boss off the downed Warden so the Mender can res.
